turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, don't worry, I will take care of Father and do as you say. I promise to find a good wife and settle down soon, so you can rest easy.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not trouble yourself with such things. The marriage and settling of our son are not your concerns now. You must rest and let me take care of these things.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, I'll help with the household duties, so you can rest more, and I'll see to it that the son's wife is well taken care of when he brings her home.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must go and see to the new daughter-in-law's dowry, Wang Lung. She will be coming to our house soon, and I must make sure that my son's wife is well cared for, as this household depends on her

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Don't worry, Mother, I'll make sure to take care of Father and the household while you're resting. I'll see to it that my wife is happy and well taken care of, just as you would have done.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not think of such things. Your health is all that matters to me now.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must finish this work, Wang Lung. The daughter-in-law's dowry is not yet settled, and I fear if I do not attend to it, it will be a burden on my son and his wife.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not think of such burdens on your son and his wife. I will see to the dowry and make sure everything is taken care of, you need only rest and focus on your health

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I know you want to make sure everything is perfect for me and my wife, but please, don't exhaust yourself. I promise to take care of all the arrangements, and Father will help too.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have done so little, Wang Lung. I must see that my son is settled before I go. His wife is young and needs guidance.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest now, I'll take care of the rest, don't worry about the dowry or anything else, I'll make sure my wife is happy and settled.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you exhausting yourself, O-lan, trying to settle our son's future. You must rest and let me take care of these things, as you always have taken care of me and our family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see that my daughter-in-law is happy and settled, Wang Lung. She is still young and needs guidance from me, not from you, my son.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I understand how much you want to help, but Father is right, you must rest now and let him take care of these things. I promise to take good care of my wife and make sure she is happy, but you must take care of yourself, too.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, perhaps it would be best if I took care of some of the household tasks, so that you can rest and concentrate on your own recovery. I will see to it that the eldest son's wife has everything she needs.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not rest, my son, until I have seen to it that your wife is happy and settled in this house. It is my duty to her, and to you, and to our family.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, please, you must listen to my husband. He knows what is best for our family, and I will see to it that the eldest son's wife is happy and settled, just as you wish.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, I will not have you exhausting yourself on behalf of our son's wife. You must rest and heal, for I need you here with me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will rest when I know that my son's wife is happy and our family is secure. I have worked hard all my life, and I will not stop now.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me and my wife. I am capable of taking care of myself and my household.

opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
